22. REMOVE NO.2 EXHAUST PIPE
(a) Remove the 2 bolts and nuts holding the No.2 front exhaust
pipe to the front exhaust pipe.
(b) Remove the 2 bolts and pipe support bracket.
(c) Remove the gasket, and disconnect the front exhaust pipe.

(d) Remove the 4 nuts, No.2 front exhaust pipe and 2 gaskets.
